items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Mona's, upstairs, was on the thing there. Mona. ... everybody heard of Mona's

ctx.x: And I played -- I went in the club there, nightclub there in San Francisco, at the International Settlement, down in the basement there, where I played. What did we call that then? What was the name of that damned place? Uh, well, Mona's, upstairs, was on the thing there. Mona.
